{变量1} lost their pack in the wilderness, and the team withdrew to the settlement injured.
A few useful things were found in the overturned carriage by the roadside.
You can turn back and take a detour, or find a way through.
The platform is deserted, with only some metal fittings left to pry loose.
The impeller keeps turning, and clean water surges through the filter pipe.

The rooftop anemometer has long since rusted solid. Rolls of wind-speed recording paper are piled in the duty room. The final page of the duty log ends with a single line: Rail resupply interrupted. All personnel evacuated.

The paper records the pattern of cold snaps across this land; the instruments' iron casings and supports are ready-made metal. Preserve the archives or dismantle the scrap metal; only one can be chosen.
The old weather station has been dismantled down to its bare frame.
Sandbags are piled outside the door of the storage room, half buried underground. Light shows through the crack, and an old surveyor and two young apprentices are standing guard inside.
They do not recognize you and have no intention of opening the door easily.
